columns.name: ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the wellness ess job alert table

columns.name: ALERT_OBJECT_ATTRS
columns.description: All attribues related to hwr alert domain objects will be mapped to this column in a separated fashion.

columns.name: ALERT_MAP_ATTRS
columns.description: All alert map attributes related to hwr alert will be mapped to this column in a separated fashion.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_USERNAME
columns.description: This is a username of hwr alert.

columns.name: IS_SENT
columns.description: This indicates if the alert is sent or not. 0 --> not sent; 1 --> sent.

columns.name: HWR_ALERT_ATTR_1
columns.description: HWR_ALERT_ATTR_1. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: HWR_ALERT_ATTR_2
columns.description: HWR_ALERT_ATTR_2. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
